integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 1502.00167 gives first submission date 2015-01-31.
integrity.full_locus_basis: The archival source identifies factorization type (d-1,1) as the unique maximal-dimensional component of the full reducible locus.
integrity.generic_degree_basis: For at least three variables, a general positive-degree factor is irreducible; unique factorization leaves exactly the permutations among factors of equal degree.
integrity.intersection_basis: The pullback of the ambient hyperplane class is the sum of the factor hyperplane classes, whose top self-intersection is the relevant multinomial coefficient.
integrity.map_basis: The archival source explicitly defines the same factorization varieties and states that multiplication induces a finite morphism from the product of factor projective spaces.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival source lists 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification primary 14N15 and 13D40.

scientific_limitations: The formula is proved for forms in at least three variables; binary forms have a different generic-factorization behavior.
It computes standard projective degree only, not defining equations, secant degrees, singularities, or full Chow classes.
The argument is short after identifying the finite multiplication map and its generic degree, so an unindexed or folklore observation remains possible.
title: Degree formula for every factorization-type variety of reducible hypersurfaces
